{{Top}}
'''Vonium''' was a precious metal used in the [[Behavioral circuitry matrix/Legends|behavioral chips]] of several expensive [[Droid/Legends|droid]] models.<ref name="sj">{{GamerCite|2|Snow Job}}</ref>

Vonium traces were found on [[Ando Prime/Legends|Ando Prime]] by an agent of [[Kaeline Ungasan]]. He then used [[Ungasan Cross Country|his podrace]] as a cover for illegally mining the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] reserves,<ref name="sj" /> until the front was discovered in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].<ref name="hn">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|sports/13328_1.html|Podracing Faces Uncertain Future}}</ref>
